coverLetter:
Dear Settify team,

I'm applying for the Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript, AI) role because your greenfield rebuild of a consumer-facing legal product sits exactly where I want to spend the next chapter of my career: TypeScript, React, and Node in production, with LLM features—prompts, tool-use, and agent flows—designed alongside domain experts who care about accuracy and client cost. Settify's place in the ATI and LEAP ecosystem, and the chance to ship without legacy debt on a funded LegalTech platform, is the kind of scoped, high-trust product work I am deliberately choosing.

Since 2018 I have shipped full-stack web products end to end—roughly seven years across enterprise banking, freelance greenfield builds, and client delivery. At CMB I worked on global wire payments (GPOW) in a regulated banking context, with disciplined TDD and strong unit-test coverage on payment flows that had to be reliable under scrutiny. On freelance and contract work I own architecture through implementation, automated testing, security, and performance—not handoffs. That maps directly to your need for someone who can design schema and APIs that survive real users, and who stays pragmatic when velocity matters.

Your stack is my daily toolkit: React, Redux, TypeScript, and Node/Express APIs, alongside Java/Spring and microservices experience from earlier roles. I integrate LLM workflows in shipping code via LangChain (open-source contributor since 2021) and a Master of Applied AI from Deakin—I focus on product integration, prompts, and reliability patterns with stakeholders, not training foundation models. Regulated client data is familiar territory: banking payment UIs, encrypted REST on a health communication portal, and accessibility-minded delivery. Legal intake and case preparation are new domain labels, but the constraints—sensitive data, clear workflows, and outcomes that affect people's lives—are ones I have worked under before.

I am based in Melbourne, open to relocating for flexible hybrid work in Sydney, and available to start after a short notice period. I would welcome a conversation about the rebuild squad, how you are approaching evals and agent flows on the new stack, and whether the scope aligns with senior end-to-end ownership.

Thank you for your consideration.

Muhammad Ahmad Naeem
